name: iLoveAPI
desc: Compress, merge, split, convert, OCR, watermark, protect and sign PDFs and images using iLovePDF / iLoveIMG / iLoveSign.

actions.name: compress_pdf
actions.description: Reduce the size of a PDF file using iLoveAPI.

actions.name: merge_pdf
actions.description: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document, in the order provided.

actions.name: split_pdf
actions.description: Split a PDF by page ranges, fixed page batches, removed pages, or target file size.

actions.name: pdf_to_jpg
actions.description: Convert PDF pages to JPG images, or extract images embedded in the PDF.

actions.name: jpg_to_pdf
actions.description: Convert one or more images (JPG/PNG) into a PDF document.

actions.name: office_to_pdf
actions.description: Convert Office documents (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, etc.) to PDF.

actions.name: html_to_pdf
actions.description: Convert a publicly accessible web page URL into a PDF.

actions.name: ocr_pdf
actions.description: Run OCR on a PDF to make scanned documents searchable. Supports 100+ languages.

actions.name: watermark_pdf
actions.description: Stamp a text or image watermark across pages of a PDF.

actions.name: protect_pdf
actions.description: Add a password to a PDF document.

actions.name: unlock_pdf
actions.description: Remove the password from a PDF (you must know the current password).

actions.name: page_numbers_pdf
actions.description: Stamp page numbers onto a PDF, with control over position and styling.

actions.name: rotate_pdf
actions.description: Rotate every page of a PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.

actions.name: extract_text_pdf
actions.description: Extract plain or detailed text (with positions and font metadata) from a PDF.

actions.name: repair_pdf
actions.description: Attempt to fix a damaged or corrupted PDF file.

actions.name: create_signature_request
actions.description: Send one or more PDF documents for electronic signature, with custom signers and signature placeholders.

actions.name: get_signature_status
actions.description: Look up the current status of a signature request, including each signer.

actions.name: send_signer_reminder
actions.description: Email a reminder to signers who have not yet completed the signature. Limited to 2 calls per day.

actions.name: void_signature
actions.description: Cancel an in-progress signature request. The document becomes inaccessible to all signers.

actions.name: increase_expiration_days
actions.description: Extend the expiration of a signature request by a number of days. Total cannot exceed 130 days from now.

actions.name: download_signed_files
actions.description: Download the signed PDF (or ZIP if multiple files). The signature must be in "completed" status.

actions.name: download_audit_trail
actions.description: Download the audit-trail PDF for a completed signature request. Useful for compliance and dispute resolution.

triggers.name: task_completed
triggers.description: Fires when a processing task finishes successfully. Optionally filter by tool.

triggers.name: task_failed
triggers.description: Fires when a processing task fails. Optionally filter by tool.

triggers.name: signature_created
triggers.description: Fires when a new signature request is created.

triggers.name: signature_sent
triggers.description: Fires when a signature request is sent to all receivers.

triggers.name: signature_completed
triggers.description: Fires when every signer has finished. Use this to drive contract-completion automations.

triggers.name: signature_declined
triggers.description: Fires when a signer or validator declines the signature request.

triggers.name: signature_expired
triggers.description: Fires when a signature request reaches its expiration date.

triggers.name: signature_voided
triggers.description: Fires when the requester cancels an in-progress signature.

triggers.name: signer_viewed
triggers.description: Fires when an individual receiver opens the document.

triggers.name: signer_signed
triggers.description: Fires when an individual signer completes their signature.

triggers.name: signer_declined
triggers.description: Fires when an individual signer declines to sign.
